test_kinematic_relationship_manager: test the KinematicRelationshipManager by initializing object-to-receptacle pairs and verifying parent-child relationships in a ReplicaCAD scene
initialize_from_obj_to_rec_pairs: create a KinematicRelationshipManager and initialize it from a mapping of object handles to receptacle names
apply_relations: apply cached relative transforms to child objects after their parent object has been translated
update_snapshots: update the previous snapshot state after removing object relationships from the kinematic graph
add_relation: add a new parent-child kinematic relationship between two objects with a specified relation type
